name: teamsherrard-realtor
description: Team Sherrard's plug-and-play AI systems for real estate agents.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-brain
plugins.description: PLUGIN 1 — install first. The Realtor AI Brain: one shared brain (the agent's identity + memory) that powers every other system. Run 'Set up my Brain' once, and every tool already knows the agent. Plus a system-wide Capture layer: talk on the go and your ideas, wins, vendors, and market notes file themselves into the Brain.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-admin
plugins.description: PLUGIN 2 — the AI Admin (The Agent Leverage OS). Books the calendar, drafts email in the agent's voice, sorts the inbox every weekday, remembers every client, briefs them at 7am. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first. Plus on-the-go Dispatch: talk while driving and it logs, reminds, and drafts for you.

plugins.name: realtor-youtube-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 3 — the YouTube System. Starts with a complete YouTube Game Plan (built on Mike Sherrard's frameworks) — channel audit, 3 high-intent pillars, ~50 exact titles, goal-math, and a 90-day plan — then ideation, research, SEO, scripting in the agent's own voice, lead magnets, repurposing, analytics, and coaching — plus a live Content Dashboard in the agent's own Notion, seeded from their Game Plan, where every video card fills with the script, SEO, lead magnet, and top-3 reference videos. Runs on the Live Data Engine — real YouTube + search data behind the audit, gap analysis, titles, references, and analytics. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first.

plugins.name: realtor-shortform-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 4 — the Short-Form System. A routine-based short-form OS: daily green-screen reactions, talking-head value, and carousels, each optimized for Instagram/Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The agent thinks in formats; Claude keeps the funnel balanced, schedules posts through their own Metricool / GoHighLevel / Buffer (bring-your-own), and reads performance from live Instagram + YouTube data — a 2-week loop, a scheduled monthly one-page scorecard, and an on-demand competitor deep dive, with reel watch-time/skip-rate hook intelligence no scheduler exposes. Shares one Notion Content Dashboard with the YouTube System (a Short-Form view of the same board). Text only — never films or designs. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first.

plugins.name: realtor-lead-capture
plugins.description: PLUGIN 5 — the Lead Capture System. A navigator front door starts every agent the same proven way: the FIRST lead magnet is locked as the relocation guide (the #1 highest-intent search traffic in every market) with a 5-question intake pre-filled from the Brain — no overthinking; niche and brand-led guides unlock from campaign two. Then it maps the opt-in funnel that gives the guide away — two aligned documents: the page copy section by section with a proof photo strip, and a pop-up opt-in (name, email, phone) landing on a thank-you page with the guide as an instant download. Plus the local-presence layer: the complete Google Business Profile kit (description, services, seeded Q&A, a month of Google posts, review replies, and the social-links setup that puts their reels on Google Maps) and platform-optimized bios for every network — Instagram to LinkedIn to YouTube — each sized to its real character limit with one consistent entity line so AI search can find them. Text only: it writes the words and the strategy (a separate design skill builds the visuals), never hosts; lead capture only, no call booking. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first.

plugins.name: realtor-ai-editor
plugins.description: PLUGIN 6 — the AI Editor. The agent talks in plain English; Claude directs Descript (their own account) to do the real editing — long-form and short-form in one tool — while they watch it happen live. Claude adds the multi-source B-roll Descript can't source itself (the agent's own footage, listing photos, free stock libraries), and a navigator skill turns vague or messy requests into one clear plan so the agent is never overwhelmed. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first, plus a Descript connection.

plugins.name: realtor-listing-launch
plugins.description: PLUGIN 7 — the Listing Launch System. One input — the address, or one sentence on the go ("Just listed 14 Oak — start the content") — and every listing becomes a content and lead-gen event. Eight stages: WIN IT (the presentation + pre-listing package that gets the signature) · LIST IT (the MLS description) · LAUNCH IT (just-listed posts + Meta ad copy) · FILM IT (room-by-room YouTube walkthrough + full SEO package) · TOUR IT (listing photos → an animated cinematic home tour, no filming, no videographer) · CLIP IT (3 just-listed shorts) · SHOW IT (the open house kit) · CLOSE IT (just-sold content queued for closing day). Plus the brochure, the postcards, and the person-to-person outreach. The property is captured once and never re-asked. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first; TOUR IT needs a Higgsfield connection and hands its clips to Plugin 6 (the AI Editor).

plugins.name: realtor-market-system
plugins.description: PLUGIN 8 — the Monthly Market System, powered by the Market Update AI Agent. It schedules itself the moment the agent installs it, times itself to when their local real estate board actually publishes (and re-times itself as it learns), then every month pulls the fresh local numbers and builds the entire package off them: the branded PRESENTATION they screen-record (talking points under every slide — no script needed), the sendable PDF market report that doubles as a green-screen asset and the lead magnet, three short-form concepts, the Instagram 1:1 infographic AND carousel, and the distribution pack with a two-CTA newsletter. Every asset ships as a paste-ready Claude Design brief with the real numbers already in it. The realtor's only job is to film. Numbers are researched once into the Brain and quoted everywhere, so nothing ever disagrees; sourced and dated or it doesn't ship. Text, data, and design briefs only — it never designs, films, or publishes. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first.

plugins.name: cohort-claude-support
plugins.description: PLUGIN 9 — Cohort Claude Support. The calm support desk inside Cowork: say "help" and it answers every Claude question, diagnoses breakage with real checks (brain missing, connector expired, skill won't fire, Claude slow), teaches in plain English with diagrams and vetted official articles, audits setup and resumes at the first missing step, tracks the cohort week with a catch-up plan, and escalates to Mike's team with a complete pre-built ticket the member pastes straight into the support portal. Knows all 9 plugins and routes every fix to the skill that owns it — support itself never touches the member's data (READ-ONLY by constitution). Stays current by design: money/limit answers are always fetched live from official pages; a weekly digest reads the Claude Apps release notes so answers stand on this week's Claude, not launch-week Claude. Works best with Plugin 1 (the Brain); helps even without it.
